content:
maya: Quick sync  ForgePath interview wrapped. They gave a crisp quote and want logo/headshot use. Asking for a brief embargo until 2026-04-08 09:00 PDT. Need signed permission + legal quick-check on comparative language.

ezra: Candidate hero: "Redwood stabilized our production latency and cut per-inference spend by roughly a third." Thoughts?

zoe: Nice. I'll draft short + long versions, 3 social tiles, and a 30s highlight clip. Planning A/B test for 48h on hero.

rana: Legal: attach transcript + attribution (name/title). If we say "a third" we need the baseline timeframe or use "~33%". Also require signed permission PDF for logo/headshot and embargo timestamp referenced. I can turn around redline in 24h once docs come in.

upload-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/forgepath-2026-03-25/transcript.v1.txt

ezra: Attribution: "Anika Shah, CTO, ForgePath". They prefer no email published. I'll request signature on the permission doc now.

pete: Lead plan: add HubSpot variant on the case study page -> set property cs_source=forgepath -> add to list `webinar-invite-forge` -> tag `cs:forge-warm` if RSVP clicked -> route to SF queue "CS - ForgePath". Also adding utm_campaign=cs_forgepath_apr. Any issues?

zoe: Also add hidden utm and 30d cookie expiry. I'll prepare assets with both hero variants.

maya: Timeline: Zoe drafts by EOD Thu, Rana redline Mon, final approval Tue, publish Wed (2026-04-08). Webinar target 2026-04-22. Can growth have the workflow live behind embargo?

pete: Yep, we can launch the form behind the embargo URL so pre-signups queue but page is blocked via robots until publish. I'll set up HubSpot this week.

ezra: Permission PDF uploaded: /permissions/forgepath/permission-signed-2026-03-25.pdf

rana: Received. I'll post any redlines by Mon 10:00 PDT. If numeric language is borderline I'll suggest switching to "~33%".

zoe: Draft checklist: landing (500-800w), long form (1200w), 3 social tiles, hero audio clip (30s), webinar invite email + landing. A/B test in first 48h.

maya: Action items:
- ezra: permission + confirm attribution (done)
- zoe: draft assets + share link (EOD Thu)
- rana: legal redline + embargo clause (Mon 10:00 PDT)
- pete: HubSpot workflow + UTMs + SF routing (this week)

maya: tagging for visibility @here :sparkles:

upload-bot: Note: raw recording retained 90 days per policy.
